stem:
Ethanedioyl dichloride, $\text{ClCOCOCl}$, is a useful reagent in organic synthesis. It can be made from compound $\mathbf{A}$ in one step.

{{figure:pdf_visual_01.png}}

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text: Suggest the identity of compound $\mathbf{A}$ by drawing its structure in the box.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: State the reagents and conditions needed to convert $\mathbf{A}$ into $\text{ClCOCOCl}$.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.stem:
Ethanedioyl dichloride is used in the following synthesis of compound $\mathbf{Q}$. It is used in a 1:1 stoichiometric ratio with $\mathbf{B}$ in step 2.

{{figure:pdf_visual_02.png}}
parts.text: Suggest the identities of the compounds $\mathbf{B}$-$\mathbf{E}$ by drawing their structures in the boxes.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: State the reagents and conditions for the following steps.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.stem: If the amount of $\text{ClCOCOCl}$ used in step 2 is decreased, another compound is formed in step 2 with the molecular formula $\text{C}_{14}\text{H}_{8}\text{O}_{2}\text{Cl}_{2}$.
parts.text:
Suggest the structure of this compound.

{{figure:pdf_visual_03.png}}

parts.label: (b)(iv)
parts.text: Identify all the steps in the synthesis of $\mathbf{Q}$ from benzene that are electrophilic substitution reactions.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Draw structures of the compounds formed when $\mathbf{Q}$ is treated with the following reagents. If there is no reaction, write 'no reaction' in the box.
